reference_policy: Reuse original archived success rows and per-pair records; never rerun reference learning.
arm: Shortened full-update HER at p=2/3. Only actual relabeled draws filter post-ALP r/ir updates to classifiers specifying >=1 goal attribute. Original and fallback draws update all rules. ALP, GA, q, action selection, step order and full-next-match-set bootstrap are unchanged.
counters: Every new row contains cumulative macroclassifier reward updates by actual origin and goal specificity, skipped blind updates, post-ALP action-set rule counts and relabeled draws with goal-specific rules. Draw counts and rule-update counts have different units.

success.primary: Equal-weight mean of checkpoint successes within each seed, all registered checkpoints.

analysis.pooling: Concatenate all three blocks, preserve recorded weights, normalize total mass; equal block mass.
analysis.F: Chosen first action is optimal; exclude random fallbacks.
analysis.C: Best fixed action per start, using all pairs and their pooled weights.
analysis.modal: Most frequent weighted chosen action at each start among nonfallbacks; lowest action index breaks ties. F_mod is its optimal-action share on the same eligible pairs.
analysis.estimate_minus_q: Mean estimate minus capped Q*(start, chosen first action, goal), all pairs including fallbacks.
analysis.estimate_above_v: Weighted share among nonfallbacks with estimate > capped V*, with a strict binary64 comparison.
analysis.within_start: All pairs, including fallbacks. Demean estimate and chosen-action Q* separately within each start; sum weighted covariance and variances across starts. Slope=covariance/variance(Q*); SD=sqrt(weighted within-start variance/total mass). Zero denominators stay null.
analysis.tie: D uses unordered distinct goals with disjoint optimal sets at one start and nonfallbacks, product weights. D_tie_implied is the different-action mass whose winners on both sides include a goal-blind rule divided by the D universe mass; D_tie_share divides that mass by all different-action mass.
analysis.intervals: Paired seed differences, sample standard deviation / sqrt(n), marginal 95% t intervals, no multiplicity correction. Undefined seed slots remain null and invalidate the interval; no dropping or imputation.

outcome.helps: Primary interval above zero on >=3 mazes and below zero on none.
outcome.trade_off: Final interval above zero on >=3 mazes and primary below zero on >=1, or primary above zero on >=3 and final below zero on >=1.

analysis.mechanism_confirmation: On >=3 of maze4, maze5, maze6, maze7, new-shortened F_mod interval is above zero AND estimate_above_v interval is below zero.
supplementary: uniform ordered-pair sensitivity pooled before reweighting
all-checkpoint F and F_mod figures against both references
analysis.labels: Only the success and final pooled mechanism contrasts above and their outcome rules are registered inferential results. Everything else is post hoc.

forecast.expected_rule: Nineteen replications of each measured seed42 CPUTimeRAW; conservatively retain per-pair overhead for compact runs.
forecast.hard_rule: max(3,ceil((2*collector wall seconds+60)/60)) per maze; every array reserves its largest cell limit for every job.
forecast.limitation: One cost seed cannot bound seed variance. All attempts, spent allocations, remaining reservations and new hard limits must fit the separately approved cumulative limit.

execution.source: Pinned clean measurement commit and unchanged static binary; frozen operations per stage.
execution.grouping: One 24-job diagnostic array (six mazes x seeds43--46), then three 30-job compact arrays (two mazes x seeds47--61). At most two streams and forty running jobs.
execution.admission: Re-derive manifests from approved registration before each sbatch; grant, expanded queue, scheduler test-only, node guards and shared STOP. Pilot + spent + reservations + new hard limits within cumulative approved CPU-hour limit.
execution.accounting: Every attempt, CPUTimeRAW allocated CPU-seconds, sacct deduplicated by JobIDRaw. Two independently checksum-verified archive copies.

stage2_deliverables: registered paired contrasts and exact outcome/mechanism decisions
F and F_mod curves over training against both references
authorization: Stage1 ends after this single plan with its forecast and the external report. No seed beyond42 is authorized without explicit stage2 approval of these plan bytes and a CPU-hour limit.
